HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW: CHAMPAGNES (10) is a smart trotting mare that keeps rising to the occasion over the last 12 months. She keeps on winning and going up in class, but also keeps stepping up. When she trots fluently, she’s hard to beat. She loves to be in front, which is unlikely here from barrier ten, but she has the class. IM EDDIE (1) is racing well and has enough gate speed to map positively here. He looks well placed if he trots well. MET WITH A SHRUG (2) has been a bit hit or miss with her manners recently. She has ability and, if she is on her best behaviour, she’s right in this. SOSO MAJESTIC (9) is a talented trotter at his best, and he’s having his sixth start back since having two years on the sidelines. He would be reaching peak fitness now. Barrier nine is suitable. BACK: CHAMPAGNES (10) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:CHAMPAGNES (10), IM EDDIE (1), MET WITH A SHRUG (2), SOSO MAJESTIC (9)

OVERVIEW: DREAMS OF LOVE (3) is an interesting trotter. As a young horse, she raced the best horses of her age group, including horses like Keayang Zahara. Since then, she has had a few different trainers and travelled interstate and probably hasn’t found her best. She now lands in the care of Kaylene Ward and is having her third start in her stable. She hit the line really nicely for third last start at Melton and will be fitter now third up. NO TELLING HEATHER (6) is a fast mare who often finds the fence early in her races. She’s a threat if she gets a good run, but the barrier does look like a challenge for her here with some fast beginners to her inside. BLACKRANGE GLORY (11) is a talented trotter, but he has his quirks. He wasn’t at his best last start, tiring late, but he was first up, so he can be excused for that. Generally, he can get it wrong with his manners, but at his best, he is very smart. Trainers request to remain ODM here as it helps him settle. WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (5) is racing well and, with luck and a good race map, is a first four chance here. BACK: DREAMS OF LOVE (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:DREAMS OF LOVE (3), NO TELLING HEATHER (6), BLACKRANGE GLORY (11), WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (5)

OVERVIEW: SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9) had his first career start on August 21 after some impressive trials. In his first start, he nearly ran down the smart FANTASY FLIGHT and was only narrowly beaten. He has ability and will improve from his first start. Barrier nine suits. BETTOR TORQUE (7) has had one career start, finishing fourth at Ararat. He looked like he was still figuring out what racing was all about but really let down nicely over the last 200m. He has a tricky barrier but seems to have ability. QUEENS BOULEVARD (2) will likely start from barrier one if the emergency does not gain a start. She was eye-catching when fourth on debut. She did it tough at Charlton and will improve on that performance. MAJOR FRIEND (3) is a well-bred filly that has placed in five of her seven career starts. She is racing well and is close to breaking through with her maiden win. Also respecting HEZ NOTTHE MESSIAH (8) and KAIDENBOY (10) if they get some luck from their barriers here. BACK: SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (9), BETTOR TORQUE (7), QUEENS BOULEVARD (2), MAJOR FRIEND (3)

OVERVIEW: This maiden trot looks to have a few chances. DELTA GEE (3) is having her second career start. On debut, she finished second after getting well back but running home well into second. In the run, she beat MI BOW (4) right on the line. MI BOW (4) is an interesting trotter. She rarely puts in a bad run, but she is a 33-start maiden. She usually just can’t find that win, but she always runs well. WHY NOW (1) has had two career runs. Last start, she got checked late when making a wide run, so that performance can be ruled out. On debut, she let down nicely for second. If she trots well, she is right in this. ALECTRONA (5) has let down nicely in her last two runs. If she gets a good trip, she will likely be flashing home again. Also respecting LEZAMA (8) here. BACK: DELTA GEE (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:DELTA GEE (3), MI BOW (4), WHY NOW (1), ALECTRONA (5)

OVERVIEW: DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (2) is looking to break through with her maiden victory at start 48 in this NR up to 38 event. Although she was beaten by 19 metres last start, she did seem to hit the line well. She can map well from barrier two. CHARLIE WALKER (6) is second up here and will improve on his first-up eighth at Maryborough. He may opt to use his gate speed here. NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (8) is racing well and always seems to put his best hoof forward on this track. He’s the only horse on the back line here, so he has options. BETSY ANNE (4) has the best sectional times in this event and flashed home very well into second last start. SELECTIONS:DRESSEDUPINTHECITY (2), CHARLIE WALKER (6), NUCLEAR ATTITUDE (8), BETSY ANNE (4)

OVERVIEW: This race looks to have many winning chances. MIKISPUR (5) has the best sectional times in this event, although his numerical form doesn’t look fantastic. If he maps well with luck, he is a good chance. JUST PEDRO (1) has got it wrong with his manners in his last two starts. However, he is good enough to win this event if he brings his best and can map well from his barrier. MAJOR ROY (6) is a lightly raced horse having his sixth start here, although he is first up. He won his last start well before going for a spell. The barrier looks awkward, however, for a horse who is first up. ARTIST (3) is an interesting runner having his second start for trainer Basil Dooley. He did get tired in his first-up run, but he’s had a month between runs now and likely will have found improvement. At his best, he’s a winning chance. SELECTIONS: MIKISPUR (5), JUST PEDRO (1), MAJOR ROY (6), ARTIST (3)

OVERVIEW: This looks to be another even contest. IMALLATTITUDE (2) is a horse who suits barrier two. He doesn’t have good gate speed, so he’s unlikely to find the front. However, barrier two suits as he stays in the running line without having to give up too much ground early. He is racing consistently well and looks well suited here. BETA THAN LOVE (1) was first up back in Victoria for trainer Samantha Gangell last start and was massively improved after a below-best QLD campaign. He’s likely to improve again and barrier one suits. KIMCHI (5) has to overcome an awkward barrier here but is racing okay and has a nice turn of foot. JUST LIKE NUGGET (4) is a horse who, although he’s only won one race, rarely puts in a poor performance. He has a great turn of foot and is well prepared by trainer Kate Hargreaves. BLUE MIKI (7) is also not far away from getting back into the winner’s circle but has a sticky barrier. SELECTIONS:IMALLATTITUDE (2), BETA THAN LOVE (1),KIMCHI (5), JUST LIKE NUGGET (4)

OVERVIEW: BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2) is a competitive mare that rarely puts in a bad run. She should be able to map well from barrier two. ROLLING REMONA (8) is having her second start for the team here. She was last first up after pulling in the run, but it was in a tougher grade. She drops down in grade here, will improve from the run and has options from barrier eight. MARGARITARI (5) was okay last start, racing in the breeze for the final lap at Charlton and wasn’t beaten too far into fourth. She will need luck here, but she races well at her best. LIKE A GAZELLE (4) is third up here and will be reaching peak fitness. She broke through with her maiden victory at this track at the end of last campaign. She looks a winning chance here with the right run. MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6) is an interesting runner to note here. She is a well-bred first starter with solid trial form. BACK: BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BETTORSWEETVICTORY (2), ROLLING REMONA (8), MARGARITARI (5), LIKE A GAZELLE (4)

OVERVIEW: OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (3) is a nice mare trained and driven by champion reinswoman Kerryn Manning. She is capable of showing gate speed and may try to get forward here. My only concern is she may not be finishing off her races recently as well as she can at her best, but she is a smart mare. KISS ME MINI (2) flashed home late well last start to only narrowly get beaten by KEAYANG PAYTON. She has ability and a great turn of foot. CELESTIAL ZODIAC (6) was an eye-catching second last start. He’s an experienced horse who is racing well but has a tricky barrier to overcome. HAPPILY (1) looks to be a promising, progressive filly. She’s only had seven starts for two wins. She’s likely to have improved with experience this time in. Barrier one is ideal, but fitness is a query. SHAZZA LOVE (5) and TOPSIES BLING (4) I also respect here. DIDMESELFAMISCHIEF (4) put together some nice runs last preparation before going for a four month spell. He finds a winnable race today and he is drawn well. The only concern is the fact that he is first up. GLITZY ALL OVER (5) will be dangerous over this journey but she is first up for a new stable. OAKHAY (2) and TAKE MY WALLET (1) are both big chances.

STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (4) hasn’t won a race for a while and his form line is hard to follow but today he finds his easiest race in a while and he is well drawn. It may pay to watch his market moves. LOCHINVAR RULER (5), TAYLAHS ACE (1) and CHILDERS ROAD (6) are also chances.

FE FE ON FIRE (6) has her first start for Ryan Hryhorec today. Her NSW form reads well. She finds an easy race today and she could easily win if she is anywhere near her best. BUBBA SCRUB (3) has had the two starts at Globe Derby for one win. He is well drawn and looks like a big threat. DON ARTHUR (8) and BITOFDUTCHCOURAGE (5) are also chances.

TWIN CONNECTION (7) has his first start for David Harding today. The draw is a concern but his new stable and his driver must be respected in this sort of race. WELL WELL (1), PARISIAN BANDIT (9) and CAPTAINS DREAM (8) are also chances.

B T CAPTIVATE (4) was very green when he was run down at Port Pirie last start. He ran second behind BROBENAH GIRL. If he can pace smoothly today he should be too classy for this field. ALICES SWEETHART (5) is another horse from NSW coming to the Ryan Hryhorec stable. His NSW form suggests he is good enough to win a race like this. LUNADIVA (6) and ULTIMATE SAFARI (3) are also chances.

FEARFULL DRAGON (1) was run down after leading last start but today is a lot easier for him. He is drawn well and he looks like the one to beat. BROBENAH GIRL (8), NORMY (7) and BLINGADINGDING (4) are also chances.

A very tricky race with not a lot of good recent form to go off. LUNCHINHEAVEN (3) ran a handy race behind MEET ME AT THE BEACH last start and hit the line well using the sprint lane. If she can get an ideal run into the race tonight then she will be a big threat. A MAJOR STARR (1) has only had four runs in two years. His stable and driver must be respected though from gate one. NEED ME SOME SUGAR (6) and SEA HUNTER (4) are also chances.

JILLIBY BLISS (3) was impressive last start here at Globe Derby when she led all of the way to defeat OMNIA by 1.2 meters. She is a good chance again tonight against a similar field. JAKEE BOY (4), DOUBLE JOEY (6) and EAGLESTONE (1) are also chances.

PARLEZVOUS PATTY (5) has been showing ability against tougher fields over the last few weeks. He is worth consideration in a race like this tonight. QUARTARARO (6) has ability but he can easily go off stride. He is a chance tonight if he can trot smoothly. IMA DESTROYER (1) and HURRICANE JANE (3) are also chances. OVERVIEW:TARA VICTORY (11) drops significantly back in grade from what she’s been facing at Melton in her seven runs this preparation. She won’t have the opportunity to use her gate speed from this draw, but based on her peak times, she’s significantly quicker than the majority of these. Earlier this season she won three from five when racing in similar grade, so if the tempo is suitable, she will be very strong late. IM WESLEY (10) is racing in career-best form this season, missing a place only four times in 16 starts. Those performances have all come with the opportunity to map well, and he now goes to the back row for the first time this season. However, there does appear to be a lot of speed off the front row, which may bring the backmarkers into it. HELLO POSSUMS (3) resumes from a break here off a couple of good trials, and her best preparation last time in saw her win two from three. She’s in the mix for the speed map, but there are a few others likely to have a look. MOMENTUM SHIFT (9) is another who finds more suitable company, having raced in strong races, often from bad draws. He can punch through off a solid tempo, and the last time he was in this ratings band he was a winner at Melton. As far as the minor money is concerned, it’s a long tail of chances, so play wide on the bottom line for exotics. BACK: TARA VICTORY (11)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:TARA VICTORY (11), IM WESLEY (10), HELLO POSSUMS (3), MOMENTUM SHIFT (9)

OVERVIEW:BULLETPROOF KID (6) has been flying this preparation and finds his most suitable race to grab a well-deserved win. When he’s been beaten in his past four runs, it has been by horses who have been competitive in quality races at Melton, and he’s gone down fighting and narrowly. He has very good gate speed to be assertive over the middle trip, and the claim of the in-form Ewa Justice, who gets on well with him, is a plus. MADAM REACTOR (5) will also run the gate, and her regular pattern is to take cover thereafter. She’s been racing honestly and likes this track, so will get her chance if that pattern eventuates. COOL STORY (10) has been racing well this season, winning two from six, and his two recent silver medals were also full of merit. He will be reliant on a solid tempo, but he’s in the mix. ANIMADO (11) has his first run since May without a trial, and although his numerical form looks plain, he has ability and loves the track. JULZ MARIE (1) and ELATED (4) have minor claims for exotics. BACK: BULLETPROOF KID (6)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:BULLETPROOF KID (6), MADAM REACTOR (5), COOL STORY (10), ANIMADO (11)

OVERVIEW:AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7) turned in a career-best run last time at his 100th start at Kilmore, running a peak mile rate and winning by 32 metres with an aggressive drive that saw him take the lead mid-race and run along. Surprisingly, that was only regular stable driver James Herbertson’s second drive on him. There may be a few looking for the top spot here, but none can put down similar times, and if he can back up that performance, he will be very hard to beat. I AM HARRO (8) can mix his form, but his best keeps him in the hunt here. He was a good winner five runs ago at Bendigo, where he came from back in the field. His last couple have been below par but he can bounce back against suitable opposition. ALDEBARAN MARCUS (9) has been sound in his past few runs and loomed up strongly last start before just peaking late. If the speed is on, it could help him work into it. Outside of those, it will come down to who gets the best run for the third/fourth spots, with KALARNEY PRINCE (6) and JESSICAS STORY (10) heading those chances. BACK: AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS:AGAINST THE BRIDLE (7), I AM HARRO (8), ALDEBARAN MARCUS (9), JESSICAS STORY (10)

OVERVIEW: OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (4) comes here fitter third-up and in suitable grade to produce his best over the short trip. He led up last time at Melton and was just outsprinted when fourth. Back to his home track, this opposition looks more suitable. Mark Pitt has had one drive on him for a win, which is another positive. TASTE IT (3) resumes here from a soft draw without a trial, but her form before going out for a break was sound enough for this grade. She gets the country’s top driver, which is a bonus. ARRAPS (6) turned in a nice effort last week when second, doing his best work late after the winner stole a march. His tactical speed gives him options from what appears a sticky draw. CLIVES GIRL (9) is always popular in the market in these races but has been a bit costly. This does, however, look to be another suitable assignment, so she is worth keeping safe. Minor chances go to MAJOR MAURIE (11), OLLY ODD POTTS (5), QUEENHIGH FLUSH (10) and ALCATRAZ GIRL (8), who are all capable of improvement with the right runs. BACK: OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (4)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (4), TASTE IT (3), ARRAPS (6), CLIVES GIRL (9)

OVERVIEW: A very even race where luck in running may well prove the difference. FINAL BOW (4) was a strong winner here last week, albeit in an easier race, but she had to earn it from the outside of the front row, making ground from back in the field and putting down solid sectionals. She can afford a positive drive from the more favourable draw and map closer this time, and if she reproduces last week’s effort, she will take holding out. TREACHEROUSTIMES (3) is a quick beginner and will likely be used from the low gate, as he was a winner here two starts back when able to lead all the way and does have a liking for this track. TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2) was great here last week in an easier race, where despite sitting parked he was too strong for the opposition in a time that may be good enough at this level. TOBYS SHOUT (6) has now had two runs for the new stable, and his last start may be an indication he’s heading in the right direction. The draw is a little tricky, but he’s in the mix. WINGATE GUY (1) and CARUSO STAR (8) aren’t without a chance from their soft draws either. SELECTIONS: FINAL BOW (4), TREACHEROUSTIMES (3), TOMMYS LOOKOUT (2), TOBYS SHOUT (6)

OVERVIEW: A very high-quality race mixing 2yos and 3yos, and there’s some potentially smart talent engaged. STRAATHDALE (3) stepped out at a recent trial at Melton and looked very smart, quickly finding the lead before extending brilliantly with a final quarter of 26.4. He had four good trials prior to that also, so he’s had plenty of experience to attempt to lead all the way on debut here. INDULGEME (4) looked very smart in a recent trial here, where he took on older horses and let down with a powerful finish. This stable is striking at an incredible rate with its young debutants at the moment, and this one looks to have plenty of promise. MY ROCKING HORSE (1) ran into one who looks really smart when recording a good second on debut and had to do it tough last time when runner-up again. Both times were sharp, and the softer draw now is in her favour. KONSTAS (8) was terrific winning on debut but now goes to the back row and will be giving some smart types a start. And we haven’t even got to the 3yos AMADA VILLMA (5), TOUCH OF REALITY (6), PIASTRI (7) and THERESHEWAS (9), all of whom would have genuine claims under these conditions normally, but they’ve struck some pretty talented-looking opposition here. SELECTIONS: STRAATHDALE (3), INDULGEME (4), MY ROCKING HORSE (1), KONSTAS (8)

OVERVIEW: Looks an impossible race with limited form to get excited about. Wide in the Quaddie. SHEER ME (3) had her first run for the new stable at Ararat and didn’t have the cleanest passage there, getting checked back to last. She found the line okay, so from a more favourable draw and set-up, she can be in the mix. AXIS ANGEL (1) followed the peg line last start in a solid field and was okay to the line. The soft draw and Herbertson help his chances. DYGNALI (2) turned in a sound performance first-up from the same draw. With added fitness, she is open to improvement. MANFREDI (6) is her stablemate and comes here first-up. Last preparation he turned in a couple of okay runs in more challenging company than he meets here. SPOT THE DEVIL (5) changes stables, so could be open to improvement, and it may pay to monitor any betting moves. SANDEE CHEEKS (7) resumed with a third from a much softer draw last time, but the winner was much better than this opposition, so she will appreciate the class drop. SELECTIONS: SHEER ME (3), AXIS ANGEL (1)DYGNALI (2), MANFREDI (6)

OVERVIEW:AUSSIE JAY MAC (7) is a horse who, when he does everything right, shows he’s smart, as evidenced last time when he ran to the lead and recorded very good time for this grade. This draw isn’t as favourable, but he retains the same driver to push forward assertively, and even if he must sit parked, he can be hard to run down. MAMMALS REASON (5) is in excellent form this season, winning three of her past four. She may map to get a decent run, and although this is tougher, she’s right in it on what she’s been showing. ELIZAJANE (3) will no doubt be popular with punters, as she often is, particularly returning to a front-row draw where she can map well. Her last win came when she was able to lead. Those likely to settle close to the peg line in KNOW THE SCORE (1), HIGHVIEW HAMMER (2) and SWEET LOUANNE (8) are in contention to fight for the minor end of the prize. SELECTIONS:AUSSIE JAY MAC (7), MAMMALS REASON (5), ELIZAJANE (3), KNOW THE SCORE (1)

OVERVIEW:OUR MYSTERY BET (7) is crying out for another win and put in one of the runs of the night last week when sitting parked in decent time, only to be swooped late. He’s a horse who always runs at even fractions, which leaves him vulnerable late, but he’s going very well. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (4) returns to the front row and looks to get a good map here, with cover likely from out wide. She was finding the line well last time out and does tend to race well at this track. DOT BALL (5) has been in good form over the past month or so, winning two of her last three. She gets the type of set-up she likes, with good gate speed around her allowing her to sit off them and come with one run. SPUN SILVER (2) is a quick beginner and will be looking for the lead here, a position she races best in, as evidenced by her two wins this season from that position. She will take running down from there. SELECTIONS:OUR MYSTERY BET (7), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (4), DOT BALL (5), SPUN SILVER (2)
